project_info.theme: High-end low-key editorial beauty portrait with wet-look hair and black ribbons
project_info.creative_direction: Tight head-to-clavicle portrait focused on tactile hair, fabric weave, soft glove texture, and emotional calm
project_info.color_palette: cool dark gray, black, natural warm skin, subtle charcoal, and soft neutral highlights

main_subject.detail: adult woman with long wavy hair, fine side braids, black satin ribbons, natural skin texture, calm direct gaze, and composed expression
main_subject.wardrobe: black semi-transparent knit top with visible weave texture and modest coverage, plus a black mesh glove
main_subject.pose: relaxed elegant pose with one gloved hand gently touching the face or chin and a slight lean toward camera

composition_elements.framing: vertical tight close-up from head to clavicle, sole subject anchor
composition_elements.background: cool dark-gray seamless background with creamy bokeh
composition_elements.details: intentional hair imperfection, fine braid detail, knit weave, glove transparency, and clean subject-background separation

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft directional key from camera-left at approximately 4300K, minimal fill, and subtle rim light
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: sculpted facial planes, preserved shadow depth, hair volume, fabric texture, and cinematic low-key mood

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with 85mm telephoto lens at f/1.8, photoreal luxury editorial
technical_specs.finish: medium-low contrast, smooth tonal transitions, low ISO cleanliness, realistic skin with light professional retouching, and editorial sharpness

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-end editorial beauty portrait of a clearly adult woman in a controlled studio setting. Use tight vertical framing from head to clavicle with the adult subject as the sole visual anchor, an 85mm telephoto lens at f/1.8, and a cool dark-gray background with creamy bokeh. Give her long wavy hair with intentional imperfection, fine side braids, and black satin ribbons. Dress her in a black semi-transparent knit top with visible weave texture and modest coverage, plus a black mesh glove. Have one gloved hand gently touch the face or chin in a relaxed elegant pose with a slight lean toward camera. Use a soft directional approximately 4300K key from camera-left, minimal fill, subtle rim light, natural warm skin tones, medium-low contrast, realistic hair and fabric, and restrained professional retouching. Keep the portrait non-sexual, adult, and free of logos or text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, transparent nudity, celebrity likeness, watermark, logo, harsh flash, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed hand, broken fabric weave, flat lighting
